messages:
maya: good morning — quick async alignment from product (what I did / blockers / today)

what I did: finalized the v2 routing spec and added rollout notes to Notion. captured fallback options and cost estimates.
blockers: need confirmation on canary QPS target (cpu vs gpu), and which fallback model variant we prefer for degraded capacity.
today: iterate on spec feedback, confirm canary traffic policy, and follow up on MR #5123 for config changes. cc @jon @rachel :wave:

jon: noted — infra recommends baseline 20 rps per GPU for sustained canary load; we can allow burst to 60 with autoscale. MR #5123 touches the router config and the traffic split. I'll drop a short diff below.

jon: ```yaml
canary:
  traffic: 0.05
  qps_target: 20
  fallback_model: redwood-lite-1.2
  observe_window_minutes: 30
```

rachel: QA: we can do smoke tomorrow AM. please add the `qa/ready` label on the MR and attach a sample prompt set (10 prompts) for the drift/quality check. also call out which logs to collect (latency + model errors).

simon: i'm on review for #5123, will get through it by EOD. two small nits on timeout defaults and one question on the cache TTL. ping me if you want faster turnaround.

liu: (data) quick ask on metrics: propose canary pass criteria = p90 latency < 150ms and error-rate < 0.5% over the observe window. if fail, auto-rollback. also want to capture per-model token cost delta.

maya: agree on thresholds. updated the spec with p90 150ms and error <0.5%. rollout plan in Notion: canary(5%) -> 25% -> 100% with 30m windows and manual hold between stages. link: https://notion.redwood/inference/v2-routing (internal)

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy window: 2025-06-12T09:00:00Z. required approvals: maya, jon, rachel. request: add `canary` tag to the release and ensure `ops/rollback.sh` is present.

rachel: QA will run smoke at +15m and full regression at +3h. i'll post results here and tag with `qa/pass` or `qa/fail`. if fail, list of top 5 failing prompts will be added.

jon: FYI i've added a telemetry flag to toggle KV cache persisting (MR #5130). this helps isolate cache-related regressions during canary. simon — want to pair on the stress test tomorrow?

simon: yes, pairing tomorrow 10:00 PT works for me. also left a comment on rollback script location — we should standardize on `/ops/scripts/rollback.sh`.

maya: thanks everyone. current blockers: none blocking release outside of jon's CR and rachel's smoke results. i'll trigger the approval flow once CR and initial QA are green. will call a 10min sync if anything fails. :thumbsup:
